_meta.description: Platform core data for ResolvrNow: choice lists, tables missing from the SDK schema (or ResolvrNow extensions), and constants. Companion of docs/spec/platform-core.md, notifications-events.md and approvals-flows.md.
_meta.basis: Each entry carries basis 'documented' (ServiceNow Brazil docs, restated), 'inferred' (SDK model, platform behavior or ResolvrNow decision), 'mixed' or 'sdk'.
_meta.columnFormat: Same keys as server/src/schema/sdk/sdk-tables.json columns (type, label, reference, maxLength, default, mandatory, readOnly, dependent, cascade) plus 'basis'. Choice lists live in the top-level 'choices' map keyed '<table>.<field>'.
_meta.systemColumns: System columns (sys_id, sys_created_on/by, sys_updated_on/by, sys_mod_count, sys_class_name) are implicit.

task.upon_approval.label: Wait for a user to close this task

sys_choice.label: Choice
sys_choice.notes: Engine column `value` uses maxLength 100; platform limit is 40 characters and numeric values in [-999, 999].

sys_number_counter.label: Counter
sys_number_counter.notes: v1 engine keeps the counter in sys_number.number; see platform-core.md 3.9.

sys_audit.label: Audit
sys_audit.notes: Journal additions are audited with oldvalue 'JOURNAL FIELD ADDITION'.

sys_audit_delete.label: Deleted Records
sys_audit_delete.notes: Not written for tables carrying the no_audit_delete attribute (documented).

sys_email.notes: Defined by the SDK schema; ResolvrNow adds no column. Value sets are under choices['sys_email.*'].

sys_watermark.label: Email Watermark
sys_watermark.notes: Stored number includes the random suffix, e.g. MSG0000008_aLJc130zDhCVuh3spXmt.

sysapproval_approver.label: Approval
sysapproval_approver.notes: Rows created manually default to 'not requested' (documented); the column default 'requested' applies to rule/flow creation.

sysapproval_group.label: Group approval
sysapproval_group.notes: Inherits parent (approved record), assignment_group (approving group), approval (group state), short_description, approval_set, due_date from task.

enforce_ui.label: Use as UI Policy on client

sys_trigger.label: Scheduled job queue entry (async business rules)

baseRoles.description: Read and some write on catalog requests, tasks and items.

baseRoles.description: Edit and publish items in assigned catalogs/categories.

baseRoles.name: catalog_manager

baseRoles.name: knowledge
baseRoles.description: Contribute to the default knowledge base; Knowledge menu.

baseRoles.name: knowledge_admin

baseRoles.name: form_admin

baseRoles.description: Configure forms, lists, rules, controls, scripts.

baseRoles.name: snc_platform_rest_api_access
baseRoles.description: Table, Import Set, Aggregate and Attachment REST APIs when their API ACLs are active.

baseRoles.name: security_admin
baseRoles.description: Elevated privilege; manage ACLs after elevation.

baseRoles.name: user

baseRoles.name: snc_external

baseRoles.name: state_model_admin

baseRoles.name: role_delegator
baseRoles.description: Delegate held roles within managed groups.

baseRoles.name: cmdb_read

savePipeline: API path: drop fields failing field ACLs, apply input
before engines: role, state model, data lookup, assignment, approval (classic), data policy
before rules order >= 1000, recompute calculated fields
validation (mandatory per data policy, max_length, unique, strict read-only, cascade restrict); abort check
database write, system fields, journal, audit, cascades
after engines: role sync, metrics, table notifications, flow trigger
enqueue async rules, commit (events commit with the transaction)
displayValueLookupOrder: display=true on the most specific table
field named name, u_name or x_name
field named number, u_number or x_number

approvalRuleTypes.edgeCases: empty or <= 0 behaves as first_response; >= 100 requires all responses
